summary: All 4 requested fixes verified at 390x844 against the public URL. Backend: 13/14 new+regression tests pass (POST oraArrivo '25:99'/'abc'/'24:00' -> 422, dataArrivo '13/11/2026'/'2026-1-5' -> 422, valid '2026-11-13'+'15:00' -> 200 persisted, empty strings -> 200, PUT 'abc' -> 422 with no change saved, PDF import still extracts 2026-10-12/13 15:00). Form: 'abc', '25:99' and '1500' show 'Formato HH:MM', save is blocked and no POST is sent; '15:00' saves (200, persisted). Ritardo checked with page clock: the 16:00 pedana is not late at 15:00 or 15:59 and is late at 16:00 and 16:30; the pedana with no ora is not late at 13:59 and is late at 14:30. Magazzino group summary shows 'Arrivo 12/11, 14/11 · 2 posizioni' (sorted). One minor edge-case bug: a time with spaces around it, e.g. '15:00 ', passes form validation but the backend returns 422 and the user sees only 'Errore del server'. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues: none checked in this scope.

minor.issue: The PedanaIn pattern runs before the .strip() in create/update, so ' 15:00 ' is rejected with 422 even though the server would trim it anyway. The frontend validates the trimmed value but sends the raw value (toApiRow does not trim oraArrivo).
The dataArrivo pattern only checks the shape, so impossible dates like '2026-13-45' are accepted (not tested in UI; the frontend itToIso probably prevents this).

ui_bugs.issue: If the user types '15:00 ' (trailing space, common on mobile keyboards), the backend returns 422 and the user sees a generic 'Errore del server' toast and cannot tell what to fix.
Any 422 validation error (where detail is an array) is shown as 'Errore del server', a misleading message for a validation problem.

issues: The 'Formato HH:MM' error stays visible after the user types a valid value, until the next save (stale error state).
The Ora field is the last field in the row, so its error text sits behind the sticky 'Registra ordine' footer; the user only sees the 'Compila i campi obbligatori' toast and the red border.
magazzino-group-summary uses numberOfLines=1, so an order with many arrival dates will cut off the position, pedane and colli counts.

action_items: In form.tsx toApiRow, trim oraArrivo (and ideally all string fields) before sending, e.g. {...r, oraArrivo: r.oraArrivo.trim(), dataArrivo: itToIso(r.dataArrivo) ?? ''}. Optionally also strip in the backend with a field_validator(mode='before') on PedanaIn.
In src/api.ts, map a 422 whose detail is an array to a clear message (e.g. 'Dati non validi: ' + detail[0].loc.at(-1)) instead of 'Errore del server'.
Optional: clear row errors in setRow when the user edits a field.
critical_code_review_comments: ritardi.ts: the logic is correct, cutoff = max(14:00, oraArrivo), applied only to pedane in 'attesa' arriving today. It uses the device's local time, which is fine.
PDF import sanitization (server.py:619-620) uses the same regexes as PedanaIn, so they are consistent.
server.py is 722 lines, over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting it.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14; the only failure is the padded-time edge case)

seed_data_creation: TEST orders TESTRIT*/TESTGRP*/TESTFORM*/TEST_VAL_*/TEST_ARR_* were created and then deleted by id. A rejected TESTPAD* was never created. No TESTX order was found. /pedane/tutte shows no TEST* leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser TZ is UTC and the machine date is 2026-11-13. page.clock.set_fixed_time('2026-11-13T15:00:00') before page.goto works for ritardo checks. Run 'python seed_ritardo_ui.py create|delete' from /app/backend/tests to create and remove the UI test data (it writes /tmp/seed_ritardo_ui.json). /pedane/tutte is capped at 1000 rows (562 currently).
